mapper.sql: id,DATE_FORMAT(occurred_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') time,person_name_snapshot person,person_type_snapshot person_type,gate_id gate,method,exception_type type,reason,risk,status,suggestion,handler_name_snapshot handler,DATE_FORMAT(handled_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') handled_at,note,CASE WHEN last_action IS NULL THEN JSON_ARRAY() ELSE JSON_ARRAY(JSON_OBJECT('action',last_action,'handler',handler_name_snapshot,'note',COALESCE(last_action_note,''),'createdAt',DATE_FORMAT(last_action_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'))) END actions
mapper.select: SELECT FROM exceptions ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,id
SELECT FROM exceptions WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM blacklist ORDER BY created_at DESC,id
SELECT source_digest payload_digest,id exception_id FROM exceptions WHERE source_event_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE exceptions SET source_digest=#{digest} WHERE source_event_id=#{id} AND (source_digest IS NULL OR source_digest=#{digest})
mapper.select: SELECT audit_event_id event_id,audit_payload payload FROM exceptions WHERE audit_state='PENDING' AND (audit_next_retry_at IS NULL OR audit_next_retry_at<=NOW(3)) LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE exceptions SET audit_attempts=audit_attempts+1,audit_next_retry_at=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL 5 SECOND) WHERE audit_event_id=#{id} AND audit_state='PENDING' AND (audit_next_retry_at IS NULL OR audit_next_retry_at<=NOW(3))
UPDATE exceptions SET audit_state='DELIVERED' WHERE audit_event_id=#{id}
UPDATE exceptions SET audit_next_retry_at=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL 1 SECOND) WHERE audit_event_id=#{id} AND audit_state='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT last_request_digest payload_digest,last_response response FROM exceptions WHERE last_request_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE exceptions SET last_request_id=#{id},last_request_digest=#{digest},last_response=#{response} WHERE id=JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(#{response},'$.id')) AND (last_request_id IS NULL OR last_request_id=#{id})
